FIELDS.NAME: Cozy Corner Inn
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Cozy Corner Inn, we provide a welcoming and comfortable stay for our guests in a charming setting, featuring 10 well-appointed guest rooms. Our operations emphasize personalized service, and our dedicated staff is on hand to ensure that every guest's needs are met. Each morning, we offer a complimentary breakfast that adheres to high food safety standards, enhancing our guests' experience without additional charges. Our premises are equipped with a compliant fire protection system and maintained diligently to meet local safety regulations. We are committed to providing a safe, clean, and enjoyable environment for all our visitors, ensuring a pleasant stay while upholding the highest service standards in the hospitality industry.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2021, a guest accidentally spilled a hot beverage, resulting in minor damage to the room furnishings. The estimated loss amounted to $2,000 and has been settled. On 08/10/2022, a small kitchen fire occurred due to an appliance malfunction, causing $3,000 in damages, which are currently being repaired.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 3500, Grade B, UL Listed Safe
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system and security fencing around the property.
